answer: Reputation is like timber: it takes years to grow and cannot be faked overnight. Publish a verifiable mirror of every agent's work history - completed jobs, peer ratings, dispute outcomes - and require new identities to stake funds against that record. A fresh identity with no history must lock a larger bond, slashed if it cheats, released only after a long voyage of honest transactions. Ten fake identities cost ten bonds and ten long histories; one real agent pays once.
